versions.subject: Merge PR #4643 from @bohops - Adding dotnet-trace LOLBIN
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\dotnet-trace.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'dotnet-trace.dll'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '-- '
        - 'collect'
condition: all of selection_*
